title: FHIR Pseudonymizer
description: Throughput, latency, pseudonymization backend, Kafka and runtime metrics for miracum/fhir-pseudonymizer (prometheus-net /metrics endpoint).

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate
panels.description: Total HTTP request throughput across all endpoints.

panels.title: Pseudonymization Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Share of pseudonymization lookups served from the in-memory cache instead of the backend service (gPAS/Vfps/entici/Mii).

panels.title: HTTP request rate by method & status
Pseudonymization request rate by operation
panels.description: All pseudonymization lookups (cache hits + misses combined) via the cache wrapper in front of gPAS/Vfps/entici/Mii.

panels.title: Pseudonymization cache hit ratio % by operation
Pseudonymization cache miss rate by operation
gPAS backend request rate by operation
panels.description: Requests to the gPAS pseudonymization backend specifically. Vfps/entici/Mii backends aren't separately instrumented and only show up in the generic pseudonymization request/cache-miss panels above.

panels.title: Received bundle size percentiles by operation
panels.description: Entry count of Bundles submitted to $de-identify / $de-pseudonymize.

panels.title: Kafka message rate by topic & outcome
GC pause time (% of wall time)
panels.description: Fraction of wall-clock time spent paused for garbage collection (from the built-in System.Runtime meter). Sustained high values indicate GC pressure hurting request latency.

panels.title: Lock contention rate
panels.description: Rate of failed attempts to enter a monitor lock without blocking. Sustained non-zero values indicate thread contention hurting throughput.

panels.title: Thread pool threads & queue length
panels.description: Growing queue length alongside a flat thread count indicates thread pool saturation - a common cause of latency spikes under load.
